V1.scale: Measured: 512 nesting levels fit in 256 KB stack; 1024 levels exceed it. Estimated ~276 bytes per recursive JSONML.parse() frame. Extrapolating to 1 MB stack (-Xss1m): approximately 3500 nesting levels trigger StackOverflowError. Each level is '<a>' (3 bytes), so about 10500 bytes of input.
